title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11363)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11363) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11363). This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 5367-1985 'Breathing tubes used with anaesthetic apparatus and ventilators*, issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISG), was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendation of the Anaesthetic, Resuscitation and Allied Equipment Sectional Committee, and approved by the Consumer Products and Medical Instruments Division Council. Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker. Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
